question: Who among the following persons composed the national anthem of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rabindranath Tagore__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Composition of the national anthem of India**

 
 
• **Jana Gana Mana is the national anthem of India** originally written in Bengali by **Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• The Indian National Anthem was composed by **Rabindranath Tagore** and **Ram Singh Thakuri** in **1911.**
 
• The national anthem of India was also written long ago, but the Government of India **approved it in 1950.**
 
• The duration of the singing of the national anthem is approximately **52 seconds.**
 
• It was sung for the first time on 27 December 1911 at a meeting of the Indian National Congress in Calcutta.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The national song of India is taken from the world-famous novel **"Anand Math" **by **the great writer of the Bengali language,** Shri Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.
 
• The song **Vande Mataram **is composed by Bankim Chandra Chatterjee in Sanskrit.
 
• It was a source of inspiration for the people in the **freedom struggle.**
 
• Its is equal to that of Jana Gana Mana.
 
• It was first sung in the** 1896 session of the Indian National Congress.**
